reason: The free report is useful and I'll let my child use the pilot, but I won't add ₹299 a month per child on top of school fees for an AI app when I don't know who checks what it teaches. I already sit with homework from the WhatsApp group every night.
objection: AI can give wrong answers, and nobody has told me which teacher or school person checks the explanations my child reads. If it teaches something wrong, I won't know until the exam.
would_change_my_mind: The school's own teachers vouching for it at the end of the pilot, with proof my child's weak topics actually improved, and a sibling price so two kids don't cost ₹600 a month.
